Quick answer

Frostallion is the most reliable source: 29 Pals can drop Ice Organ, and 49 of them drop it guaranteed every kill. The fastest farm is to repeatedly defeat the highest-level Pal on the list while a ranch or production line covers the rest.

How to farm Ice Organ

  • Target the guaranteed drops first — a 100% drop means one kill equals a fixed amount with no luck involved.
  • Alpha variants often add extra copies on top of the normal drop, so take the Alpha when it is nearby.
  • Pair the farm with a breeding chain so you always have a supply of the source Pal without hunting.
  • Check your base production: some sources are passive once the right structure is built.

What Ice Organ is used for

Ice Organ is used for cool-resistant gear and cooling-related crafting.
